issue.title: XSS in UTable cell renderer via unsanitized column formatter output
issue.body: ### Description `UTable`'s `cell` render function for a column injects the returned string directly into the DOM without escaping it. If the value comes from user input (e.g. a name field), an attacker can inject a script. ### Proof of concept ```js const columns = [{ accessorKey: 'name', cell: (row) => row.name }] const rows = [{ name: '' }] ``` Rendering this table executes the `onerror` handler and can exfiltrate cookies from any page that renders untrusted data in a column. ### Impact Any app that renders user-controlled strings through a `UTable` column formatter is vulnerable to stored or reflected XSS.
issue.author: securityresearcher
